Translation.Variant Videos Count Help: How many different variants to generate from one request. Default 1 = you get exactly the single video you asked for. Higher numbers create N alternative versions of the same video, each using a different scene selection from your source material (so you can pick the best, or A/B test). Each variant counts as one generation against your quota.

Translation.Video Fit Mode Help: Fill uses the entire output canvas and crops excess edges. Fit preserves the complete source frame and adds black bars when needed.

Translation.llm_provider_tips.apimart:
##### APIMart Configuration
- **API Key**: register through the [MoneyPrinterTurbo referral link]({api_key_url}) and create a key in the console
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`, using the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoint
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; [view the model list](https://apimart.ai/model?type=chat)

APIMart can generate video scripts and extract stock-footage search keywords. Its image and video generation APIs are not yet connected to the current material pipeline.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.azure:
##### Azure OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: obtain one from the [Azure Portal]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: required; enter the Azure OpenAI endpoint, such as `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com`
- **Model Name**: enter the Deployment Name; see the [deployment guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/create-resource)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.claude_code:
##### Claude Code Configuration
- **API Key**: not required; the local `claude` CLI authenticates with your Claude subscription (Pro / Max / Team)
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: optional; leave empty to use the CLI default, or set `claude-opus-5` / `claude-sonnet-5`
- **Claude CLI Path**: optional; leave empty to resolve `claude` from PATH
- Requires the CLI to be installed and logged in where MoneyPrinterTurbo runs. In Docker, pass a `claude setup-token` token as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
- Requests use your Claude subscription usage limits. Conflicting `ANTHROPIC_*` / `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*` environment variables are stripped before the CLI runs, so an API key in the environment cannot silently bill your API account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway

- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list]({model_docs_url})

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Exclusive offer for new users**: receive bonus API credit equal to 10% of the first successful top-up, up to CNY 1,000; offer ends September 30, 2026

Translation.llm_provider_tips.oneapi:

Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:
##### OpenAI Configuration

- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service

Translation.llm_provider_tips.openrouter:
##### OpenRouter Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in [OpenRouter Keys]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use another model ID from the [free model list](https://openrouter.ai/models?variant=free) if availability changes

Recommended free alternatives for this workflow: `z-ai/glm-5.2:free` or `openrouter/free`. Free endpoints are rate limited and may change availability.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.pollinations:
##### Pollinations AI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Pollinations]({api_key_url})

Translation.llm_provider_tips.qwen:
##### Qwen Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [DashScope]({api_key_url})

Translation.llm_provider_tips.shengsuanyun:

Translation.llm_provider_tips.volcengine:
##### VolcEngine Ark Configuration

Translation.tts_provider_tips.azure-tts-v2: Requires an Azure Speech **region** and **API key**. Create or view them in the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_ProjectOxford/CognitiveServicesHub/~/SpeechServices).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.chatterbox: Self-hosted. Run a compatible [Chatterbox TTS API](https://github.com/travisvn/chatterbox-tts-api), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the API key is usually optional.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.elevenlabs: Requires an [API key](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys). Add voices to your favorites in the [Voice Library](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library) first.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.fish_audio: Requires a Fish Audio API key from the [developer portal](https://fish.audio/app/developers). [Browse public voices](https://fish.audio) or configure custom voices in `config.toml`. See [pricing & terms](https://fish.audio/pricing).
Translation.tts_provider_tips.gemini-tts: Requires a Gemini API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey). [Preview all supported voices](https://aistudio.google.com/generate-speech) in Google's Voice Library. Pace and style are controlled through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.kokoro: Self-hosted and free: run a compatible [Kokoro-FastAPI](https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI) server (Apache-2.0 model, CPU is enough), then enter a Base URL ending in `/v1`; the voice list is read from the server.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.mimo-tts: Requires a Xiaomi MiMo API key; see the [first API call](https://mimo.mi.com/docs/quick-start/first-api-call). MiMo V2.5 controls pace and style through natural-language instructions.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.minimax-tts: Use a MiniMax TTS API key from the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/user-center/basic-information/interface-key) or [global platform](https://platform.minimax.io/user-center/basic-information/interface-key). The key and endpoint must belong to the same platform. If left empty, the MiniMax LLM key and its matching endpoint are reused.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.siliconflow: Requires a SiliconFlow API key from the [console](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/account/ak). Numeric speed and volume gain are supported.
Translation.tts_provider_tips.voicestudio: Self-hosted and free: run the local [OmniVoice](https://github.com/k2-fsa/OmniVoice) server (`vendor/voice_studio/server.py`, OmniVoice-based), then upload a short clean audio sample to clone a profile (e.g. a voice from a few seconds of speech). The profile is then usable as a regular voice.
